<html lang="en">
<head>

<title>Vignesh — Founder, Hyna Studio</title>
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Oswald:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=Anton&display=swap');

  :root{
    --ink:#18130f;
    --red:#a32b26;
    --red-deep:#5f1815;
    --cream:#efe6d2;
    --cream-dim:#e3d8bd;
    --paper:#f5efe0;
  }

  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}

  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}

  body{
    background:var(--paper);
    color:var(--ink);
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
    overflow-x:hidden;
  }

  ::selection{background:var(--red);color:var(--cream);}

  /* ---------- Eyebrow / utility ---------- */
  .eyebrow{
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
    font-size:11px;
    font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:.28em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    opacity:.75;
  }

  /* ---------- Top mark ---------- */
  .topmark{
    position:fixed;
    top:28px;left:32px;
    z-index:50;
    color:var(--cream);
    mix-blend-mode:difference;
  }
  .topmark .name{
    font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;
    font-weight:700;
    font-size:18px;
    letter-spacing:.06em;
  }
  .topmark .sub{
    font-size:9px;
    letter-spacing:.32em;
    opacity:.8;
  }

  /* ================= PIN / SCROLL-ZOOM SECTION ================= */
  .pin-wrap{
    position:relative;
    height:260vh;
  }
  .pin-sticky{
    position:sticky;
    top:0;
    height:100vh;
    overflow:hidden;
    background:var(--ink);
  }
  .hero-img-wrap{
    position:absolute;
    top:50%;left:50%;
    transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1);
    transform-origin:center center;
    will-change:transform,filter;
    filter:brightness(1);
    width:min(88vw,1200px);
    height:min(82vh,800px);
    border-radius:22px;
    overflow:hidden;
    box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  }
  .hero-img-wrap img{
    width:100%;
    height:100%;
    object-fit:contain;
    background:#0b1622;
    display:block;
  }
  .zoom-scrim{
    position:absolute;
    inset:0;
    background:radial-gradient(120% 100% at 50% 40%, transparent 0%, var(--ink) 78%);
    opacity:0;
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .hero-caption{
    position:absolute;
    left:0;right:0;
    bottom:64px;
    text-align:center;
    color:var(--cream);
    opacity:1;
    transition:opacity .2s linear;
  }
  .hero-caption .eyebrow{color:var(--cream);}
  .hero-caption h1{
    font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:15px;
    letter-spacing:.02em;
    margin-top:6px;
  }
  .scroll-cue{
    position:absolute;
    bottom:24px;right:32px;
    color:var(--cream);
    font-size:10px;
    letter-spacing:.3em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    writing-mode:vertical-rl;
    opacity:.7;
  }

  .reveal-panel{
    position:absolute;
    inset:0;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    padding:6vw;
    opacity:0;
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .reveal-inner{
    max-width:640px;
    color:var(--cream);
    transform:translateY(30px);
  }
  .reveal-inner .index{
    font-family:'Anton',sans-serif;
    font-size:clamp(60px,10vw,120px);
    line-height:.85;
    color:var(--cream);
    opacity:.9;
  }
  .reveal-inner .index sup{
    font-size:.32em;
    top:-1.4em;
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
    font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:.05em;
  }
  .reveal-inner h2{
    font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:clamp(20px,2.6vw,30px);
    line-height:1.35;
    margin-top:18px;
  }

  /* ================= BIO CONTENT ================= */
  .bio{
    position:relative;
    background:var(--cream);
    padding:min(14vw,140px) 8vw 120px;
  }
  .bio::before{
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    top:0;left:0;right:0;
    height:1px;
    background:var(--ink);
    opacity:.12;
  }
  .bio-grid{
    display:grid;

    max-width:1180px;
    margin:0 auto;
  }
  .bio-label{

    top:120px;

    font-family:'Anton',sans-serif;

  .bio-label .dob{
    margin-top:6px;
    font-size:12px;

    letter-spacing:.06em;
  }

  .bio-copy h2{
    font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;
    font-weight:700;
    font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,46px);
    line-height:1.15;
    max-width:16ch;
    color:var(--ink);
  }
  .bio-copy p{
    margin-top:26px;
    font-size:17px;
    line-height:1.75;
    max-width:58ch;
    color:#33291f;
  }
  .bio-copy p + p{margin-top:20px;}

  .pullquote{
    margin:56px 0 0;
    padding-left:28px;
    border-left:3px solid var(--red);
    font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;
    font-weight:500;

  }
  .pullquote span{
    display:block;
    margin-top:10px;
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:11px;
    letter-spacing:.24em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--ink);
    opacity:.55;
  }

  .facts{
    margin-top:64px;
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
    gap:28px;
    max-width:58ch;
  }
  .facts div{
    border-top:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.15);
    padding-top:14px;
  }
  .facts .f-num{
    font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;
    font-weight:700;
    font-size:22px;
    color:var(--red);
  }
  .facts .f-cap{
    margin-top:4px;
    font-size:11px;
    letter-spacing:.14em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    opacity:.65;
  }

  .launchpad{
    max-width:1180px;
    margin:100px auto 0;
    padding-top:48px;
    border-top:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.15);
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:minmax(260px,380px) 1fr;
    gap:48px;
    justify-items:start;
    align-items:start;
  }
  .launchpad-img{
    width:100%;
    aspect-ratio:1672/941;
    overflow:hidden;
    border-radius:18px;
    background:var(--ink);
  }
  .launchpad-img img{
    width:100%;
    height:100%;
    object-fit:contain;
    display:block;
  }
  .launchpad-copy{
    max-width:52ch;
  }
  .launchpad-copy h3{
    font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;
    font-weight:700;
    font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,32px);
    margin-top:8px;
    color:var(--ink);
  }
  .launchpad-copy p{
    margin-top:16px;
    font-size:16px;
    line-height:1.7;

  }

  @media (max-width:820px){

  /* ================= FOOTER / CLOSE ================= */
  .close{

  }

  @media (max-width:820px){
    .bio-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px;}
    .bio-label{position:static;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:16px;}
    .facts{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    .hero-img-wrap,.reveal-panel,.zoom-scrim,.hero-caption{transition:none !important;}
  }
</style>
</head>
